# AuraPass™ Enterprise — Full Technical Architecture & Knowledge Manifest

## Executive Summary
AuraPass Enterprise replaces traditional plastic RFID cards, fingerprint biometric hardware, and consumer cloud face-recognition apps with an on-premise computer vision attendance and access verification engine. Designed for Indian manufacturing facilities, educational institutions, tech parks, and multi-shift operations, it retrofits standard RTSP security cameras into high-speed walk-through verification portals.

---

## Comparison: AuraPass vs Legacy Alternatives

| Feature / Criteria | Traditional Plastic RFID Badges | Wall-Mounted Fingerprint Machines | Cloud Facial SaaS Apps | AuraPass™ Enterprise On-Premise |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **New Hardware Cost** | ₹80–₹150 per card replacement; badge printers | ₹45,000–₹85,000 per entrance gate | Proprietary tablet or phone locks | **₹0 extra** (runs on existing CCTV cameras) |
| **Check-In Speed** | 3 to 5 seconds per employee (causes lobby queues) | 4 to 8 seconds (fails on dusty/wet hands) | 2 to 4 seconds (requires standing still) | **Under 1 second** (<300ms walk-through) |
| **Buddy Punching Prevention** | 0% (badges easily shared between coworkers) | Partial (susceptible to silicone dummy prints) | Partial (photos on phones often pass basic cameras) | **100% Eliminated** (ISO 30107-3 Liveness Anti-Spoof) |
| **Data Privacy & Sovereignty** | N/A | Local template storage | **High Risk**: Transmits raw face photos to third-party cloud | **100% Private**: Runs on local LAN; zero cloud egress |
| **Internet Outage Resilience** | High | High | **Fails completely** when office internet drops | **100% Resilient**: Continues operating offline without interruption |
| **India DPDP Act 2023 Compliance** | Low security | Basic | Requires cross-border data transfer disclosure | **Full Compliance by Design** (biometric sovereignty) |
| **Shift & Grace Period Tracking** | Manual spreadsheet reconciliation | Fixed rigid intervals | Per-seat monthly subscription fee | **Automatic**: Configurable shift grace rules & exports |

---

## Enterprise Case Studies

### 1. Higher Education Campus — NIRMA Institute of Technology
- **Environment**: 8 entrance turnstiles, 2,400+ students and faculty members arriving within a 30-minute morning window.
- **Problem**: RFID badge lines backed up 40+ meters into the parking lot. Buddy punching was prevalent among students sharing access cards.
- **Solution**: 4 overhead Hikvision DS-2CD IP cameras installed above turnstile lanes linked to a single local AuraPass server with 24V relay triggers.
- **Results**: Average verification latency dropped to 260ms. Morning check-in queues completely disappeared. Over ₹3.5 Lakhs saved annually on replacement badges.

### 2. Heavy Engineering & Fabrication Facility — Rajkot Industrial Area
- **Environment**: 450 shift workers handling metal cutting, oil, and dust.
- **Problem**: Optical fingerprint scanners failed on 38% of workers due to soiled, worn, or dusty fingertips, requiring manual supervisor override books.
- **Solution**: Overhead ambient cameras mounted at eye level outside the main gate operating with InsightFace ArcFace wide-angle model routing.
- **Results**: Zero touch required. Check-in success rate reached 99.8%. Payroll disputes over missing punches dropped to zero in the first month.

### 3. Multi-Tenant IT Park — Adani Shantigram
- **Environment**: 12 speed-gate lanes handling 3,200 tech employees across 14 tenant companies.
- **Problem**: Strict tenant NDAs prevented uploading biometric face photos to shared multitenant cloud servers.
- **Solution**: AuraPass multi-tenant vector enclaves with tenant-level cryptographic separation.
- **Results**: Complete compliance with India's DPDP Act 2023. Real-time audit logs provided to tenant compliance officers with zero data egress.

---

## Technical Hardware & Integration Guide

### Camera Protocols
- **RTSP Ingestion**: `rtsp://<username>:<password>@<camera-ip>:554/Streaming/Channels/101`
- **Recommended Resolution**: 1080p (1920x1080) at 15–20 FPS with H.264 or H.265 compression.
- **Minimum Face Bounding Box**: 160x160 pixels.
- **Luminance Threshold**: 300 to 700 Lux standard diffuse lobby lighting.

### Turnstile Relay Wiring
- **Voltage**: 24V DC opto-isolated dry contact.
- **Relay Duration**: 450ms momentary active-low pulse to trip speed gate solenoids.
- **Safety Standard**: Automatic fail-open relay configuration during fire alarm circuit trip or system power interruption.
